name: Report to Rog'mar
summary: An Orc directs you to Rog'mar, an outpost in the embattled Riverglades. Report to Krom'rosh, whose experience has helped the outpost endure repeated attacks.

sections.title: An Outpost Endures
sections.body: The Riverglades lie northeast of Stonard along the eastern coast. Many have tried to claim the land, though few have managed it. Rog'mar is a small outpost that has survived countless attacks. You are sent there to report to Krom'rosh, an old ally whose battle experience has helped the outpost endure.

faq.answer: Rog'mar lies in the Riverglades, northeast of Stonard along the eastern coast.
You are to report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost.
Rog'mar is a small outpost in the Riverglades that has endured countless attacks.
Krom'rosh's experience battling enemies has helped the outpost endure.

faq.q: What kind of land are the Riverglades?
faq.answer: The Riverglades are an embattled land along the eastern coast, northeast of Stonard.

attribution: In-game quest text: Report to Rog'mar
